selection_policy: Source-wide inclusion across full TED2013 and TED2017 training events: directly adjacent labeled interviewer/respondent turns (allowing only standalone stage cues between), explicit label at both starts, and either an interviewer question mark or at least eight interviewer words and eight respondent words. Fragmented starts, unassigned speakers and brief nonquestion acknowledgments are excluded. All eligible exchanges are included. Existing v1 records and the entire development/test selection are unchanged. No heldout model run or heldout score was consulted.
source_hash_definition: TED publisher_caption_sha256 from tools.transcripts.ted. Lex SHA256 of canonical UTF-8 JSON array of {id,speaker,text,start}, sorted keys and compact separators; HTML file hashes can vary independently.
